claim_scope: Closed content-addressed interruption-recovery observations and deterministic fenced decisions only; no real process, container, journal, database, approval, or workflow action.
retained_invalid_attempts: The first focused test lacked the standard src path bootstrap and executed no test.
The first full-schema wrapper could not resolve its exact source URLs and acquired no artifact.

A CLI --help inspection returned the expected IS_USAGE because help is outside the frozen machine grammar; the supported policy status command was used instead.
One read-only CLI search was rejected by PowerShell quoting before rg executed; the corrected literal search completed.
The first policy status invocation used a nonexistent fixture path and returned IS_MANIFEST_READ; the corrected exact path returned MISSING at exit 12.
limitations: The contract does not yet implement host leases, runtime observation, process stop, journal append, resume, or orphan cleanup.
No real interruption boundary has been executed or recovered under IS4-U04.
No workflow manifest is approved and workflow execution remains unavailable.

decision.next: Commit and push the exact recovery contract, replay it from credential-free public custody, then implement the host-only fenced recovery surface in a separate bounded stage.
